repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an unnecessary absolute-value correction for the temperature difference (lines 4-7). The IR computes $t2 - t1$ directly without folding negative results. This extra logic changes the semantics, triggering the action on a drop of 3 degrees when the IR only triggers on a rise of 3 degrees.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value folding logic. The script now strictly computes $diff = t2 - t1$ and checks if it is >= 3, matching the IR's signed difference semantics.
